definition: Generated check or match output that records results and issues but is not source authority
Registered item matrix produced by its R builder
Project code that transforms or checks source material
Project-authored field or measure definition requiring item-level review
Project-authored lookup from printed keys to citations or names
Unadopted taxon or other metadata proposal
Issue and resolution ledger with row-level statuses
Published or author-supplied source or frozen source snapshot
Reviewed project-level crosswalk or decision table used as an active authority
